newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures erode more late, most end off.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures erode more late, most end off.

text.p: March 31 - IMM currency futures eroded in erratic late trade, most ended lower and near lows. June Swiss franc fell again late when one house sold 1,500 and on other market-on-close sales. Brokers said renewed retreat in US stocks had muted effect, given shallow cash markets Monday. June marks failed after briefly recovering above $0.6000, or about 1.6750 spot.
